testsuite.name: dev.proxyaudit.core.ProxyCooperationTest

testcase.name: missing connections and invalid entries retain version but do not invent a count
credentials validation and plan tostring do not expose inputs
non-json media type and malformed json are distinguished without raw body
close before execution starts no request and plan can execute only once
per request timeout is three seconds even when system DNS ignores interruption
only two permitted GET endpoints send authorization and preserve field compatibility
trusted certificate with wrong host fails hostname verification
origin input requires explicit https and rejects credentials path query fragment and invalid ports
cancel active call returns promptly retains completed version and omits later results
absent secret never sends authorization header
response byte ceiling rejects declared and chunked oversized payloads
snapshot count is complete but exported metadata sample is capped at 100
deep json and long strings fail bounded parser instead of escaping budget
version failure stops before connections and 401 403 404 have separate classifications
redirect cannot contact another endpoint or disclose credential there
duplicate IDs invalidate snapshot including duplicates outside retained sample
alternative IP casing and typed ports are accepted and malformed optional ports omitted
503 retry-after zero does not trigger library protocol retry
untrusted certificate fails without retry or certificate data export
response echo of secret is scrubbed in version id host chain rule and every report format
uninterruptible DNS does not spawn workers and retains global admission until release
empty and null connections are compatible successful zero snapshots
